description: Agent Travel: submit the change terms on a booking with the change as it was handled: the terms with whether changes are allowed, the change fee and currency, the hours before the original departure by which a change must be made, whether a name change and a route change are allowed and how a fare difference is settled (pay the difference, pay or refund it, or no difference); optionally the original booking with its reference, traveler, origin, destination, departure and fare; and the change with when it was requested and made, the traveler, origin, destination and departure after it, the new fare, the fee charged and the fare difference charged and refunded. The signed report gives the terms, the original and the change, the hours from the change to the original departure against the window, the fare difference worked out from the two fares with what the rule says to charge or refund beside what was charged and refunded, the fee charged against the fee in the rules, and whether the traveler or route moved against the rules, and counts them, and names a mishandled change: a change the rules leave closed, a change made past the window, a fee above the rules, a fare difference charged other than the two fares give, and a traveler or route changed where the rules keep them; then a lower fare’s difference kept where the rules refund it and a change record that leaves out the new fare, the fee or the difference, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No statement of whether changes are allowed, no change fee, no window or no time of the change, no difference rule or no original fare leaves the change unverified. This reads one change to one booking against its fare rules: two versions of a terms text are wever_terms-change-check, a quoted amount against the settled charge is wever_price-truth-check and a purchase’s terms against governing terms are wever_terms-match-check. Verdict travel_change_mishandled, travel_change_partial, travel_change_unverified or travel_change_per_terms. POST /api/travel-change-check. Reads the travel records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, booking or external write. Agent Travel reads a travel purchase an agent made, after the fact, from the traveler’s own records: the booking against the travel authorization, the itinerary against the trip as requested, the passenger details against the traveler’s ID, the fare rules against what the buyer was told, a change and a cancellation against the fare rules, the extras against what was authorized and needed, and a disruption against the carrier’s stated policy. Beside it, the Sports Trips tools such as wever_sports-trip-status plan, book and read a trip held on Wever, while a travel check reads a purchase made anywhere against its own records; wever_delegated-authority issues and reads the grant itself, while the authorization check reads one booking’s price, dates and class against the travel authorization behind it; and the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read a tokenized asset purchase, while a travel check reads a travel booking. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-travel-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-travel/.
